purpose: Isolate the numerical effect of original versus explicit serialized SAC defaults on one fixed CPU; not a trading-performance screen or CrossQ retry.
initialization: Original pinned unfitted full64 SAC seed11 NPZ and all original Torch/NumPy/Python streams. Verify actual copied tensors and empty optimizers before native updates.
preupdate_randomness: Restore original streams separately for each arm; reproduce one stochastic actor prediction at row1000 before the single native train call. Record all pre/post RNG hashes.
optimizer_settings: Original resolved metadata versus current fixed SAC settings serialized through JSON. Effective settings must agree; native tuple/list and int/float default representations remain as recorded.
interpretation: Equality rules out a numerical effect of these representations for this fixed input/backend only. Difference localizes it for this input/backend only. Neither result establishes the historical host's cause or trading performance.

execution.failure_policy: One allocation, no automatic retry. Persist original ledger and diagnostic baseline; stop on unreliable monitoring; bounded retrieval then verified owned cleanup on all outcomes. Include setup/idle/download/failure charges.

authorization_boundary: This registers a separate two-update SAC numerical diagnosis under existing research authorization. It does not authorize resuming the stopped CrossQ study, changing its thresholds, or interpreting its partial performance.
